PZEF.description: Panel Zone Effect (PZEF). A single-key (id "1") global setting controlling panel zone offset calculation; all three fields are applied together on OnSet.

OPT_OFFSET.description: Auto Calculate Panel Zone Offset Distances. true = automatically calculate the panel zone offset distances; false = do not calculate.

OFFS_FACTOR.description: Offset Factor applied to the calculated panel zone offset distances.

OUTPUT_POSITION.description: Output Position (result-report location) for the panel zone: 1 = Panel Zone, 2 = Offset Position.
